lines.t: (Verse 1 – soft, ancient, Middle-Eastern tone)
Like a root from barren ground He came,
No crown of splendor, no earthly fame.
We did not see Him, we turned our face,
Yet He carried all our sorrows in His grace.
He bore the weight no mortal soul could bear,
Our grief upon Him, our shame laid there.
Like a Lamb before the slaughter,
He did not speak,
Holy and lowly… humble and meek.
O YahuShua, chosen and true,
All of our brokenness carried by You…
Man of Sorrows, lifted high,
Wounded Lamb who chose to die.
By Your stripes, the nations heal,
By Your pain, the truth is revealed.
O Adonai, our hearts proclaim—
Blessed is the One who came in The Lord’s name.
Rejected, beaten, yet silent still,
Suffering Servant who fulfilled the will.
In every bruise, in every tear,
The love of Heaven drew us near.
O YahuShua, pure sacrifice,
You paid the cost, You gave the price…
Man of Sorrows, lifted high,
Wounded Lamb who chose to die.
By Your stripes, the nations heal,
By Your pain, the truth is revealed.
O Adonai, our hearts proclaim—
Blessed is the One who came in The Lord’s name.
You carried our shame,
Forever the same.
Kadosh, Kadosh…
You opened the grave,
Graceful and mighty to save.
Man of Sorrows, risen high,
Holy Servant glorified.
Every sorrow You endured,
Every promise stands secure.
O Lord, we lift Your name—
Honor to the One who came,
Honor to the Lamb who reigns.
Blessed be The Name…
O Lord…
We remember You.
